The '''Coruscant Industrial Zone Detention Center''' was a [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] located in the [[Industrial District/Legends|Industrial District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Episode Guide" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Evil Plans Date">{{TCWdates|308}}</ref> the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] used the facility as [[Gender/Legends|his]] base of operations. There, he had [[Interrogation droid/Legends|torture droid]] [[J0-N0/Legends|J0-N0]] interrogate [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] for information on the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="Evil Plans" />
